reviewer: Root agent, independent of dataset author; no evaluated model responses observed
method: Read all original source excerpts against the rubric; re-read corrected cases and compatible scope annotations. Structural checks supplement semantic review.
resolved_findings: Nested upper-bound conflicts replaced with mutually exclusive values.
Version and temporal compatibility now has explicit applicability.
Upload-limit insufficient case no longer gives explicitly different channels.
Renewal-notice case has comparable claims with missing applicability and a separate invoice distractor.
Fraud routing explicitly separates high-risk and low-risk cases.
Compatible gold scopes identify application scope rather than repeat claim text.
Source identifiers and filenames are anonymous within each isolated case; facts and labels are unchanged.
limitations: Synthetic records frequently state qualifiers explicitly; results cannot establish performance on realistic noisy enterprise evidence.
Scenario fixtures are distinct, but business topics recur across splits.
Mechanical graph links do not establish semantic source support; misleading assertions remain intentional.
